summary: IRSA Investments & Representations Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of Series XXV Notes in the local Argentine market for USD 50 million. The notes carry a 3.75% interest rate, issued at 100% of par, with a one-year maturity and semiannual interest payments. The issuance follows a pro-rata allocation of bids totaling USD 64.5 million. Proceeds will be used to refinance existing liabilities and for working capital in Argentina. This is a routine debt refinancing; noteholders receive principal at maturity. Watch issuance proceeds deployment and refinancing impact.
